Whatever, I used a script to replace all my comments with a generic message to let people know I'm leaving the site and for what reasons. After editing roughly 200 maybe 300 of my comments (in the process of editing them all anyway) I was shadow banned.

http://nullprogram.com/am-i-shadowbanned/#gatordontplaythatsht

I get why, not saying they're wrong for it or anything like that; at least not according to how they want reddit to be.

Kudos to them, but myself, like a great many people who've already left, and like some considering; am just so goddamned sick of the horrible way this site is run from the top down. The administrators seem to fluctuate between naive disconnectedness and meta jokes that fix nothing. They "apologize" for running a shit show, and then patronize the community by offering moderator tools. Unless "moderator tools" meaning deleting 75 percent of the mods on this site, this fixes nothing.

I could talk cabal, or srs, or srd for ages, and anyone that recognizes my profile name knows that I have. Let's forget those groups for a second, and let's acknowledge that regardless of whatever agenda people think certain mods are pushing the mods of this site have been out of control with banning, removals, and their community interactions for a very long time now.

Subreddits have had to leave their initial sub and create other subs to avoid certain toxic moderators. Moderators will preemptively ban users from 100 plus subreddits, that haven't even posted in those subs before. Moderators all hang out in different IRCs, mocking the very users they're meant to serve. Any mention of transparency, or a moderator voting system (at least on defaults) is quelled and mocked almost immediately. They have entire subreddits dedicated to mocking the average site user, and admittedly many of them hate a majority of the very site they moderate. How any site admin could allow moderators who actively mock the users, and vocalize complete disdain for the site, continue to moderate in such an incompetent fashion is beyond me.

Power is the problem on reddit, not content. The moderators have so much power that they were even able to get attention from the admins, at a time when users were in revolt and could get no response (blackout). The moderators on defaults have removed and deleted hundreds of comments and submissions that break no rules, yet for every one that's pointed out nothing happens. Why? There is no system on reddit for punishing or removing moderators, it's happened, but rarely. As the administrators say, they don't like to get involved; and boy is that true. I could list a few examples, and if the comments go well maybe ask around or do a search for bad mods. There's a great many examples of entire subs moving house because of 1 or 2 bad mods, another thing no responsible site admin would allow to happen on what is essentially a massive and popular forum.

Weirdly, as much as people complain about, and point out how horrible and biased the moderators are nothing happens. You'd never know it reading a lot of the comments but They want the admins involved in policing and removing bad moderators

I've seen a lot of comments related to fixing the moderation issue on reddit, and tons of very good suggestions on how to do so. The fact is this isn't an issue for the admins, and they don't give a shit.

Well I can't deal anymore, I can't be on a site that I once so proudly perused for quality content and almost unbiased information. I can remember during the OCCUPY movement, sitting on the bus passing the BOA tower in Charlotte and seeing all the demonstrators, knowing that a majority of them were redditors. At that time I was not only happy to be on reddit, I felt proud of my generation and our internet savvy way of sharing information that put MSM to shame. I can't say that anymore.

I see threads every day now with "comment grave yards." I see moderators everywhere, even in subs meant to call out their bad behaviors; responding with nonsense to any accusation, and being upvoted by their bully friends. The moderation here has become so not about moderating the site, that many mods have subs dedicated to themselves, or meta trolling, so that anytime anyone accuses them of anything they can simply out meta the accuser and circle jerk the issue away.

This will be my last post, I hope the mods here allow it. I'm not really sad to go, it's not as bittersweet as I wish it could be, and I'm not really good at goodbyes. My name is the same on the site I feel best represents what I'm looking for, so if you want you can find me there.

See ya guys
